newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CNB SETS 13-WEEK BILL AUCTION FOR THURSDAY.
newsitem.headline: CZECH CNB SETS 13-WEEK BILL AUCTION FOR THURSDAY.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) said on Wednesday it set a Dutch-style auction of a five billion crown tranche of 13-week liquidity bills for Thursday.
The CNB said that the maximum gross yield was set at 12.20 percent, and the maximum net yield would be 9.15 percent.
The gross yield in a similar central bank auction two weeks ago was 12.0 percent.
The three-month Prague interbank offered rate (PRIBOR) stood at 12.19 percent on Wednesday, unchanged from Tuesday.
